say:0:1012125101:0.text: Why did the hornleaf bears suddenly attack the village?
say:0:1012125101:0.source_cn: 叶角熊怎么会突然闯进村子？
say:0:1012125101:0.male: Why did the hornleaf bears suddenly attack the village?
say:0:1012125101:0.female: Why did the hornleaf bears suddenly attack the village?

say:1:1012125102:0.text: Who knows? They just went berserk!
say:1:1012125102:0.source_cn: 谁知道发疯的熊在想什么！一转眼它们已经在村子里打滚了！
say:1:1012125102:0.male: Who knows? They just went berserk!
say:1:1012125102:0.female: Who knows? They just went berserk!

say:2:1012125103:0.text: Let's expel them one by one!
say:2:1012125103:0.male: Let's expel them one by one!
say:2:1012125103:0.female: Let's expel them one by one!
